figures.caption: Table 1: Comparison of Universal Approximation Results Most Relevant to Theorem 5.1. Here “in our class” means belonging to the attention-only softmax Transformer class in Definition 3.3, without postattention FFNs or other not Transformer-native parts. Equivalently, the approximation capability comes solely from the softmax attention mechanism. Here “constructive” means that the approximating architecture is constructed end-to-end. The direct benchmark for Theorem 5.1 is [Hu et al., 2025, Theorem G.1].
